text: Jada's knee op is finally booked for May 14. She's been waiting nearly a year so she's relieved but also a bit terrified of the anaesthetic. Remind me to text her the night before.
saskia bday sometime in june?? she didnt say exact date. into pottery atm, wants a wheel eventually lol

Called Gustavo. His dad had a fall last weekend and is in hospital for at least another week, they're saying hip replacement probably but nobody's confirmed anything. Gus sounds knackered, he's been driving up every evening after work and then working late to catch up. His partner's holding the fort at home with the dog. I should offer to drop a meal round.

Ayesha turns 30 on 2 November 2026. Big party planned at her sister's place, fancy dress, theme is the nineties. She's obsessed with that Korean skincare brand at the moment, the one with the snail stuff, could get a set. Also mentioned she's been wanting a silk pillowcase forever. Ask Jada if she wants to go halves.
note to self - dentist moved to 6/3, 9:40am
Emre said his mum's scan results come back sometime next month. Don't forget to check in with him around then.
Jen's off work for a while after her gallbladder surgery, recovery's slower than they said. Her husband's doing all the school runs.
Dmitri - running the Berlin marathon next year, training from January. Hates gels, only eats jelly babies on long runs

So, um, just got off the phone with Caroline, she said Pooja's moving to Leeds in the spring, not sure exactly when, and they're doing a leaving dinner for her probably end of March. I should ask Caroline what the plan is for a group gift.
Imogen cancelled her trip to Lisbon, her surgery got brought forward to April 8th instead. Wants it over with tbh.
Yosef's daughter Nia has her tonsils out on Thursday. She's six and really scared about it. Must send her something silly, she loves dinosaurs.
Ellie's birthday is Oct 30. she's into bouldering and specialty coffee. mentioned her chalk bag is falling apart 👀
Dimitri and his wife are expecting! due March 2027. They've not decided on names. He was beaming.
Ran into Jorge at the shop. Back's still bad after the physio, he's got another appointment after Christmas. Seemed fed up.
need to buy bin bags, oat milk, and renew the car insurance before the 25th
Bethany passed her driving test this morning!! third attempt. remind me to get her a little keyring or something
Connor's dad passed away last week, funeral's on the 12th. He's ok-ish, keeps busy. Ring him at the weekend.
Chioma mentioned her and Kwame's anniversary is August 9, ten years. They're going to Zanzibar for it. She wants a proper camera for the trip.
Kate (Katie from uni) is having her wisdom teeth out soon, maybe in a couple of weeks. Hates needles. Text her good luck before.

Ok so Joy says the twins start nursery in January, probably the second week, she wasn't sure. She's way more nervous about the drop-off than they are, she said she'll probably cry in the car park. Her husband can't take time off so she's doing the first few days on her own. Their older one, Pedro, is apparently thrilled to have the house back to himself.
Dong's restaurant opening got called off, the lease fell through. He's looking at other sites sometime later in the year.
Louis is a huge Arsenal fan, season ticket holder. Birthday in like two weeks I think? Shirt maybe.
Spoke to Ahmed today. His wife Laila had her baby on Monday, a little girl, both doing well. Need to send a card and maybe drop round some food next week once they've settled.
Abigail's surgery went fine yesterday, she's home already. ask how the first week of recovery goes
Amy - vegan, allergic to cashews, lives in Bristol now with her partner. Loves crime podcasts.
Pedro's got an MRI on 11/18 for the headaches. Doesn't want a fuss. I'll check in after quietly.
emily and her brother Connor are throwing their parents a surprise 40th anniversary thing in the summer, date tbc. emily wants me to bake

Amara's cat Biscuit had emergency surgery tonight for a blocked bladder and has to stay at the vet overnight, maybe two nights. She's in bits, she's had him since uni. The bill is going to be enormous as well and she's only just started her new job at the library so money's tight. Message her tomorrow morning to see how he's doing.
Phone call with Gustavo again. Dad's out of hospital as of Tuesday, staying with Gus and his partner for a few weeks while he gets back on his feet. Gus is sleeping on the sofa basically.
I'm getting my eyes tested on the 4th and the boiler service is sometime next week, need to chase them for a slot
Jada's op went ahead on the 14th, all good apparently. Remind me to ask her how the physio is going.
Saskia confirmed — her birthday is June 21st. Dinner at that tapas place on the Saturday after.
Caroline's husband is in for a heart procedure on December 3rd. She's putting a brave face on it but she's clearly worried. Their kids don't know yet. Should take her out for lunch before.

Imogen's out of hospital. Sore but cheerful, already complaining about hospital food and asking for proper coffee. She's off work till at least mid-May, possibly longer if the stitches play up. Her mum's come down from Edinburgh to stay for a fortnight. I'm going round on Sunday with magazines and the good biscuits.
Ayesha's party is off actually, her grandad's unwell so they're doing a quiet family meal instead.

Kwame starts his new job at the council after half term, the 3rd I think. He's a bit nervous about the commute, it's two trains and a bus, and his manager sounds intense. Chioma's chuffed for him though, he's been wanting out of the warehouse for ages. Don't forget to text him on his first day.

Dr Fischer said Emre's mum needs a second biopsy, so it's dragging on into the new year. Emre is not coping great honestly, he's barely sleeping and his boss isn't being very understanding. I need to call him this week, properly, not just a text.
Pooja's leaving dinner is March 28. Her favourite thing is matcha anything. Caroline's collecting for a gift.
Bethany's mum is having a hysterectomy in February, Beth's taking a week off to look after her.
Yosef said Nia was a total star at the hospital, eating ice cream the same afternoon. Bless.
Ellie wants a moka pot apparently, she keeps sending me links
Jorge's sister is getting married 5/22 in Seville, the whole family's flying out the week before. He's best man and dreading the speech.

Long chat with Dimitri. Wife's had some bleeding so she's on bed rest for now, scan on Friday to check everything's okay. He's trying to work from home as much as possible. Asked me not to mention it to the others yet. I should check in with him Friday evening after the scan.
Connor wants to do a memorial walk for his dad sometime in the spring. Said he'd let me know.
remember: bday card for Uncle Louis, his 70th is Jan 6
Joy's mother-in-law moves in with them at the end of the month. Joy's dreading it.
Kate's teeth done, face like a hamster lol. All fine. Off work till Monday.
Chioma's been signed off with burnout for a month, from November 1st. Doesn't want visitors but said messages are fine.
Amy and her partner bought a flat!! Get the keys sometime in the new year, January or February. Remind me to get them a housewarming plant.
Pedro's MRI was clear, he's relieved. Back to football next week.
Bought the present for Ellie already, the moka pot. Hidden in the wardrobe.
Dong's mum has a hip replacement scheduled for 17 January 2027 and Dong is flying back to Shanghai for a month to help out with her recovery. He leaves on the 10th. Text him before he goes.
Abigail's into sourdough now and wants a proper banneton for her birthday on Sept 2.
Emily's brother Connor has his appendix out tonight, emergency. Emily's going to the hospital now. Don't know much more.
Must sort the gym cancellation before the next payment, and book flu jab
Laila said the baby's got a check-up at six weeks, around Dec 9. Ahmed's going back to work after that.

Jen texted back, she's going back to work part time from next month, three days a week to start with. Says she's tired but getting there, still can't lift anything heavy. She's got really into audiobooks while recovering, mostly long fantasy series, she's halfway through the Wheel of Time. Might get her an Audible credit or two, her birthday's sometime in the autumn anyway.
Gustavo's birthday soon, early December-ish? He's been saying he needs a decent pair of walking boots. Could split it with his partner. Ask Gus's partner what size he takes.
Nia (Yosef's eldest) has her ballet show on April 12, she's got a solo. Very nervous apparently.
Felt like a good day. Nothing much to note.
